model_class: plant single-cell expression encoder with species adapters, hierarchical annotation paths and a runtime annotation head
claim_scope: A reproducible plant single-cell annotation framework. The current frozen evidence establishes behaviour on a defined public corpus and cross-species evaluation set; it does not establish uniformly high-accuracy annotation for every plant species.

architecture.adaptation: LoRA adapters and runtime adapter-resolution interface
architecture.gene_transfer: exact gene identifiers followed by an ortholog-mapping contract when an appropriate map is supplied

frozen_current_corpus.boundary: Historical manifest/catalogue rows and adapter registry entries are not equivalent to cells in this frozen profiled corpus.

exploratory_global_context_v14.reporting_boundary: Exploratory sensitivity result. It is not the primary strict headline because the global configuration choice uses information across outer folds.

runtime_full_vocabulary_head.reporting_boundary: Deployment/readiness analysis with a trained full-vocabulary annotation head. It is not a strict leave-species zero-shot result.

intended_uses: build embeddings for plant scRNA-seq or snRNA-seq cells that satisfy the documented gene contract
run a validated strict-transfer, few-shot-adaptation or runtime-annotation workflow with the correct protocol label
derive ranked marker candidates for follow-up biological validation
instantiate a new species adapter after providing gene identifiers or an ortholog map and then validating on held-out cells
not_established: universal high-accuracy zero-shot cell annotation across all plants
official numerical superiority over scPlantLLM or scPlantAnnotate
a completed Saussurea involucrata single-cell atlas

reproducibility.hardware_record: The historical training artefacts record RTX 4090 runs. The currently accessible remote session did not expose a CUDA device on 2026-08-01; no active GPU training is claimed by this card.
